# Jason Vertucio

> Personal site and blog of Jason Vertucio, a lead front-end engineer with
> full-stack depth. Resume, writing, and selected projects.

This site exposes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server so agents can query it
directly instead of scraping pages.

## AI work and endpoint documentation

- https://jasonvertucio.com/ai — what Jason has built with AI, and the
  human-readable documentation for the endpoint below.

## MCP endpoint

- URL: https://jasonvertucio.com/mcp
- Transport: streamable HTTP (JSON-RPC over `POST`; `GET` returns 405 by design)
- Credentials: none required

Tools:

- `get-resume-data` — experience, skills, education and projects
- `get-recent-blog-posts` — recent posts with titles, summaries and URLs;
  supports a keyword `search` argument
- `get-site-info` — site title, selected projects and interests

## Access levels

Calling anonymously returns the public projection: direct contact details
(email address, phone number) are omitted. The LinkedIn profile and site URL
are included as contact paths.

Presenting a bearer token returns everything that token's owner is permitted to
see. Tokens are issued by request, not self-service — ask through the contact
options on the site. An invalid or revoked token is rejected rather than
silently downgraded, so a reduced response is never mistaken for a complete one.

- Blog: https://jasonvertucio.com/blog
